newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Oct copper output up 6.66 percent yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Oct copper output up 6.66 percent yr/yr.

text.p: China's copper output was 745,900 tonnes in January-October, up 6.66 percent compared with the same period a year ago, China Securities said on Tuesday.
Copper output in October alone was 81,500 tonnes, a rise of 10.58 percent from the year-ago period, the newspaper quoted figures from the State Statistical Bureau as saying.
Production of copper materials in January-October was down a year-on-year 4.08 percent to 536,200 tonnes, it said.
Output of copper materials in October alone was 55,200 tonnes, a rise of 9.52 percent, it said.
